governance.rule: Domain identities are branded after the wire boundary; new bare-string IDs fail the staged strict gate.

constructorTiers.use: required trusted interior value or owned mint
optional config or soft merge; blank becomes undefined
wire, JSON, CLI, form, or environment ingress
narrow an already-canonical unknown value; does not prove provenance

brands.name: RequestId
brands.description: HTTP or RPC request correlation handle

brands.name: AccountId
brands.description: Cloud account (e.g. Cloudflare/R2 account) — env/wire only, never empty forge

brands.name: AccessKeyId
brands.description: S3/R2 access key id (not the secret material)

brands.name: TokenId
brands.description: Opaque token handle (not the token secret)

brands.name: ZoneId
brands.description: DNS / Cloudflare zone — mint from wire via parseZoneId

brands.name: DocTokenId
brands.description: Bun documentation token identity (catalog / TokenRef northstar)

brands.name: AuditEntryId
brands.description: Polymorphic audit SSOT ref (finding or concept id)

brands.name: EvidenceId
brands.description: Screenshot / image evidence row (UUID v7 via Bun.randomUUIDv7)

brands.name: TreeNodeId
brands.description: Ops tree node (partner / agent / sub_agent) identity

brands.name: ExperimentVariantId
brands.description: One design cell (factor combination) in an experiment

brands.name: PartnerProfileKey
brands.description: Partner profile binding key for tree node ↔ template

brands.name: GateDecisionId
brands.description: Policy gate decision row for play dispatch

brands.name: OpsChannelEventId
brands.description: Unified ops channel outbox event id

brands.name: StateCode
brands.description: US state jurisdiction code for regulatory scoping (MA, NJ, …)

brands.name: ZipCode
brands.description: US ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code (discrete geo column)

brands.name: PortalTenantId
brands.description: Multi-tenant portal tenant key (factory | science | tennis)

brands.name: TelegramUserId
brands.description: Telegram user id from Bot API

brands.name: PortalAccountId
brands.description: Portal user account primary key (UUID v7)

brands.name: LinkNonceId
brands.description: Telegram link nonce for account binding

brands.name: HostId
brands.description: Public edge FQDN (no scheme/path) — config/surfaces.toml host

brands.name: AccessDomainId
brands.description: Cloudflare Access app domain field (host or host/path)
